answer: select uuid from cards where borderColor='borderless' and (cardKingdomId is null or cardKingdomFoilId is null)
select distinct name, artist, isPromo from cards where uuid in (select uuid from rulings group by uuid having count(*)=(select max(c) from (select count(*) c from rulings group by uuid)))
select count(distinct c.uuid) from cards c where (c.power is null or c.power like '%*%') and exists(select 1 from rulings r where r.uuid=c.uuid and r.text like '%triggered ability%')
select 100.0*sum(c.hasContentWarning=0)/count(*) from cards c where exists(select 1 from legalities l where l.uuid=c.uuid and l.format='commander' and l.status='Legal')
select count(distinct s.code) from sets s join set_translations t on t.setCode=s.code where s.block='Ice Age' and t.language='Italian' and t.translation is not null

select l.format, c.name from legalities l join cards c on c.uuid=l.uuid where l.status='Banned' and l.format=(select format from legalities where status='Banned' group by format order by count(*) desc limit 1) group by l.format, c.name order by c.name

with t as (select artist, count(*) n from cards where availability like '%arena%' and borderColor='black' and power glob '[0-9]*' and cast(power as integer)>=10 group by artist) select artist, n from t where n=(select max(n) from t)
select count(distinct artist) from cards where availability like '%arena%' and availability not like '%mtgo%' and borderColor='black' and power glob '[0-9]*' and cast(power as integer)>=5
select c.colors, count(distinct l.format) from cards c join legalities l on l.uuid=c.uuid and l.status='Legal' where c.id between 1 and 20 group by c.colors

select cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId from (select name, cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId from cards where types like '%Creature%' and cardKingdomFoilId is not null and cardKingdomId is not null order by cast(cardKingdomFoilId as integer), cardKingdomId limit 3) order by name, cardKingdomId
select count(distinct name) from cards where text is not null and frameVersion='2015'

select s.name, s.releaseDate from sets s where s.type=(select type from sets where name='From the Vault: Lore') and not exists(select 1 from set_translations t where t.setCode=s.code and t.translation is not null and t.translation<>'') order by s.releaseDate

select g.name, g.type, coalesce(sum(rc.n),0) as total_rulings from (select distinct f.name, c.type, c.uuid from cards c join foreign_data f on f.uuid=c.uuid and f.language='Japanese' where c.watermark='boros') g left join (select uuid, count(*) n from rulings group by uuid) rc on rc.uuid=g.uuid group by g.name, g.type
select count(*) from foreign_data f join cards c on c.uuid=f.uuid join sets s on s.code=c.setCode where s.name='Coldsnap' and f.language='Italian' and f.text is not null and f.text<>''
